modules.title: Math Foundations
modules.outcomes:
Translate mathematical notation into checked tensor operations.
Derive and verify gradients with analytic, numerical and automatic methods.
Use least squares, SVD, probability and uncertainty correctly.
Explain optimization and numerical failure modes.
Deliver a reproducible mathematical notebook with meaningful tests.
modules.description: 7 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Translate mathematical notation into checked tensor operations.

modules.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning
modules.outcomes:
Build a leakage-safe data and model-selection workflow.
Implement and debug linear, MLP and CNN baselines.
Explain attention shapes, masking and Transformer components.
Evaluate predictions, probabilities and uncertainty with correct denominators.
Report a controlled, reproducible model comparison.
modules.description: 8 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Build a leakage-safe data and model-selection workflow.

modules.title: Trustworthy AI
modules.outcomes:
Define a risk context and precise adversary capabilities.
Evaluate bounded adversarial and local backdoor experiments with clean controls.
Distinguish empirical defense evidence from formal guarantees.
Explain differential-privacy assumptions and group-metric tradeoffs.
Produce a reproducible audit, model card and risk register.
modules.description: 7 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Define a risk context and precise adversary capabilities.

modules.title: Distributed and Federated Learning
modules.outcomes:
Define global/local objectives and weighting policies.
Implement and verify FedAvg and the FedProx local objective.
Build and audit IID and heterogeneous client partitions.
Compare quality, client outcomes, local work and communication budgets.
Distinguish simulation, secure aggregation and differential privacy.
modules.description: 7 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Define global/local objectives and weighting policies.

modules.title: Efficient Machine Learning
modules.outcomes:
Define parameter, storage, compute and runtime resource metrics.
Measure latency under a reproducible workload and report its limitations.
Explain and implement pruning, quantization, low-rank and distillation examples.
Distinguish trainable parameters from deployed representation and execution.
Build a measured Pareto comparison with honest quality/resource tradeoffs.
modules.description: 7 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Define parameter, storage, compute and runtime resource metrics.

modules.title: Mini-project
modules.outcomes:
Turn a broad interest into a testable research question.
Map primary-source evidence and document reproduction fidelity.
Predeclare a protocol and preserve auditable artifacts.
Complete one assigned pillar project with a controlled extension.
Write, reproduce and defend a bounded research conclusion.
modules.description: 6 detailed lessons with derivations, worked examples, runnable CPU code, exercises, self-checks and primary readings. Turn a broad interest into a testable research question.

lessons.title: Tensors, shapes and linear maps
lessons.description: Core time: 90–120 minutes, plus exercises. Prerequisites: basic Python, sums and multiplication. Outcomes: translate a model expression into array shapes; compute dot products and norms; distinguish matrix multiplication from elementwise operations; diagnose broadcasting errors.

lessons.title: Least squares, rank, SVD and principal components
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: tensor shapes and dot products. Outcomes: interpret least squares as projection; recognize rank deficiency; use a numerical solver instead of an inverse; connect singular values to compression and PCA.

lessons.title: Gradients, matrix calculus and the chain rule
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: affine layers, squared error and elementary derivatives. Outcomes: derive a batch gradient with correct dimensions; trace a computation graph; verify an analytic gradient numerically; explain what automatic differentiation does and does not check.

lessons.title: Probability, Bayes' rule and likelihood
lessons.description: Core time: 100–120 minutes. Prerequisites: fractions, sums and logarithms. Outcomes: distinguish a random variable from an observed value; compute conditional probabilities; use Bayes' rule without ignoring base rates; connect maximum likelihood to classification losses.

lessons.title: Estimation, uncertainty and honest comparisons
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: expectation, variance and conditional probability. Outcomes: identify an estimand and unit of analysis; separate sampling variability from training variability; compute a paired comparison; interpret an interval without turning it into a probability claim about a fixed parameter.

lessons.title: Optimization: curvature, stochastic gradients and adaptive steps
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: gradients, expectations and matrix rank. Outcomes: analyze gradient descent on a quadratic; distinguish an objective from an optimizer; explain minibatch noise; compare momentum and Adam without claiming universal superiority.

lessons.title: Mathematical foundations laboratory: from equations to checked evidence
lessons.description: Core time: 2–3 hours. Prerequisites: Math 1–6. Outcomes: organize a numerical experiment; choose meaningful assertions; connect numerical conditioning, gradient correctness and uncertainty; prepare the first assessed artifact.

lessons.title: A reproducible learning problem and a leakage-safe data workflow
lessons.description: Core time: 90–120 minutes. Prerequisites: setup guide, arrays and basic probability. Outcomes: define inputs/targets and the deployment question; reserve an appropriate test set; fit preprocessing only on training data; preserve split identifiers and a baseline.

lessons.title: Supervised baselines, losses and regularization
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: likelihood, gradients and data splitting. Outcomes: relate losses to modeling assumptions; derive logistic gradients; select regularization with validation data; interpret a baseline beyond headline accuracy.

lessons.title: PyTorch: autograd and a complete training loop
lessons.description: Core time: 2–3 hours. Prerequisites: gradients, baselines and Python functions. Outcomes: build an MLP; explain every training-step operation; separate training/evaluation modes; save and restore a validation-selected checkpoint.

lessons.title: Convolutional networks: locality, shared weights and shapes
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: affine layers and PyTorch training. Outcomes: compute convolution output dimensions and parameter counts; explain weight sharing; implement a small CNN; compare architectures under a declared budget.

lessons.title: Attention and Transformers: a small calculation before a large model
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: matrix multiplication, softmax and neural layers. Outcomes: track query/key/value shapes; calculate attention weights; explain scaling, masking and positional information; distinguish a toy attention block from a trained language model.

lessons.title: Evaluation: imbalance, thresholds, calibration and uncertainty
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: conditional probability, uncertainty and classification. Outcomes: derive metrics from a confusion matrix; distinguish ranking, decisions and probabilities; select thresholds/calibration on validation data; report denominators and uncertainty.

lessons.title: Debugging experiments and making results reproducible
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: a working training loop and evaluation metrics. Outcomes: isolate data/model/optimizer faults; preserve exact selection evidence; distinguish deterministic replay from reproducible conclusions; write an actionable experiment log.

lessons.title: ML/DL laboratory: a baseline, an ablation and a defensible conclusion
lessons.description: Core time: 3–4 hours. Prerequisites: ML/DL 1–7. Outcomes: predeclare a comparison; run linear and neural baselines; isolate one design choice; report actual uncertainty and limits; prepare the module assignment.

lessons.title: Trustworthy AI begins with a risk model
lessons.description: Core time: 100 minutes. Prerequisites: ML evaluation and probability. Outcomes: distinguish reliability, robustness, privacy and fairness questions; specify a threat model; separate distribution shift from intentional manipulation; design a bounded audit.

lessons.title: Adversarial robustness: gradients, constraints and measured failure
lessons.description: Core time: 2–3 hours. Prerequisites: gradients, norm budgets and a trained classifier. Outcomes: derive an FGSM step; implement projected iterative evaluation on your own model; verify perturbation constraints; distinguish empirical attack accuracy from certified robustness.

lessons.title: A controlled backdoor study on a local teaching model
lessons.description: Core time: 2–3 hours. Prerequisites: training/evaluation separation and threat models. Outcomes: distinguish backdoors from ordinary test-time perturbations; construct a bounded training-only poisoning experiment; report clean and triggered metrics with correct eligibility; test a meaningful negative control.

lessons.title: Evaluating defenses without a false sense of security
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: adversarial and backdoor experiments. Outcomes: compare clean utility and attack resistance; identify gradient masking symptoms; specify defender knowledge; design an adaptive, budget-aware evaluation plan.

lessons.title: Privacy: membership risk, differential privacy and the meaning of a guarantee
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: probability, expectations and training workflows. Outcomes: distinguish access controls from statistical privacy; define neighboring datasets; calculate sensitivity for a bounded statistic; explain composition and the ingredients of DP-SGD without inventing an epsilon guarantee.

lessons.title: Group evaluation, fairness criteria and calibrated claims
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: confusion matrices and calibration. Outcomes: compute group-conditioned rates with support counts; distinguish common fairness criteria; identify tradeoffs and missing context; avoid treating a toy metric as a social or legal verdict.

lessons.title: Trustworthy-AI laboratory: a bounded audit with reproducible evidence
lessons.description: Core time: 3–4 hours. Prerequisites: Trustworthy AI 1–6. Outcomes: produce an auditable threat model, implement controls, report correctly conditioned metrics and write a model card with justified limitations.

lessons.title: Distributed and federated learning: objectives before architecture
lessons.description: Core time: 100 minutes. Prerequisites: supervised objectives and gradient descent. Outcomes: distinguish centralized, distributed and federated training; define an example-weighted objective; identify statistical/system heterogeneity; separate a local simulation from a deployment.

lessons.title: FedAvg: implement and verify a complete round
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: global/local objectives and gradient descent. Outcomes: implement client initialization, local updates and weighted aggregation; distinguish parameters from deltas; test aggregation on an exact numerical case.

lessons.title: Non-IID data: partitioning, client drift and evaluation
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: FedAvg and probability. Outcomes: distinguish label, quantity and feature skew; build a reproducible partition; diagnose local drift; report pooled and client-level metrics without confusing their weights.

lessons.title: FedProx, local drift and personalization
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: FedAvg, gradients and non-IID partitions. Outcomes: derive a proximal local gradient; test the zero-penalty equivalence; distinguish a shared global model from personalized models; design adaptation without test leakage.

lessons.title: Communication, participation and system budgets
lessons.description: Core time: 100–120 minutes. Prerequisites: federation rounds and resource units. Outcomes: calculate a declared payload model; distinguish bytes, rounds and wall time; identify participation bias; compare compression without ignoring metadata.

lessons.title: Federated security, secure aggregation and privacy boundaries
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: threat models, DP and FedAvg. Outcomes: distinguish transport security, aggregation confidentiality and DP; explain cancellation of pairwise masks conceptually; identify poisoning and participation assumptions; avoid claiming security from locality alone.

lessons.title: Federated-learning laboratory: a controlled heterogeneity benchmark
lessons.description: Core time: 3–4 hours. Prerequisites: FL 1–6. Outcomes: run a transparent simulator; verify aggregation/partitions; compare IID and non-IID conditions under stated budgets; report client-level outcomes and system limitations.

lessons.title: Efficient ML: define the resource before optimizing it
lessons.description: Core time: 100 minutes. Prerequisites: neural layers and evaluation. Outcomes: calculate parameter storage and arithmetic counts; distinguish training/inference costs; identify activation and optimizer memory; define a multidimensional efficiency question.

lessons.title: Measure latency, memory and throughput honestly
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: resource accounting and evaluation mode. Outcomes: design a repeatable benchmark; report distributions and units; separate batch latency from throughput; distinguish parameter bytes from measured peak memory.

lessons.title: Pruning: sparsity, structure and the cost of zeros
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: neural layers and efficiency measurement. Outcomes: implement magnitude pruning; distinguish masked dense weights from sparse storage; explain structured removal; compare quality and cost with an appropriate baseline.

lessons.title: Quantization: representation error and actual execution
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: numerical precision and resource measurement. Outcomes: implement a simple quantizer; calculate clipping/rounding error; distinguish weight storage from integer inference; explain calibration and quantization-aware training.

lessons.title: Low-rank factorization and LoRA: two different efficiency questions
lessons.description: Core time: 120 minutes. Prerequisites: SVD, dense layers and parameter accounting. Outcomes: replace a dense matrix with rank-r factors; verify exact reconstruction at full rank; distinguish compressing weights from adapting a frozen model; account for merged and unmerged inference.

lessons.title: Knowledge distillation: a teacher, a student and a fair comparison
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: logits, cross-entropy and training loops. Outcomes: define a temperature-scaled distillation objective; keep the teacher frozen; compare with an equally trained hard-label student; report teacher-training cost separately.

lessons.title: Efficiency laboratory: build and interpret a Pareto frontier
lessons.description: Core time: 3–4 hours. Prerequisites: Efficient ML 1–6. Outcomes: compare several representations under one workload; distinguish measured and analytical metrics; identify nondominated options; make a bounded deployment recommendation.

lessons.title: From a broad interest to a testable research question
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: foundations and at least one pillar. Outcomes: delimit a research question; build a primary-source evidence map; separate reproduction, replication and extension; write a short protocol before inspecting final outcomes.

lessons.title: Build an experiment package another researcher can inspect
lessons.description: Core time: 2 hours. Prerequisites: a focused question and reproducible lab experience. Outcomes: organize code/configuration/data provenance; preserve raw evidence; define checks and a clean reproduction command; document data and artifact boundaries.

lessons.title: Capstone brief: Backdoor Robustness Reproduction
lessons.description: Estimated project effort: 12–20 hours after the Trustworthy AI module. Prerequisites: the clean/poisoned local experiment, metric eligibility and a written protocol. Complete this capstone only if assigned by your administrator; the other capstone briefs are alternatives.

lessons.title: Capstone brief: Federated Learning Under Non-IID Data
lessons.description: Estimated project effort: 12–20 hours after the FL module. Prerequisites: a checked FedAvg simulator, partition auditing and budget accounting. Complete this capstone if assigned; the trustworthy and efficiency briefs are alternatives.

lessons.title: Capstone brief: Efficient Model Trade-off Study
lessons.description: Estimated project effort: 12–20 hours after Efficient ML. Prerequisites: a trained baseline, measurement protocol and one compression/adaptation technique. Complete this capstone if assigned; the other two briefs are alternatives.

lessons.title: Write the report, reproduce the evidence and defend the conclusion
lessons.description: Core time: 2–3 hours, plus revision. Prerequisites: completed assigned experiments and artifact inventory. Outcomes: connect claims to evidence; write informative captions and limitations; reproduce a selected result; respond to review constructively.

projects.description: Investigate a controlled training-only backdoor mechanism on your own small model. Compare clean utility and non-target attack success under a precise threat model, with a clean-model trigger control and a reproducible extension.
Compare IID and label-skewed federated training under a declared local-work and communication budget. Verify weighted aggregation, report client/global outcomes and test one controlled extension.

Measure the predictive-quality and resource tradeoff of one model-efficiency intervention. Use a fixed workload, valid baseline, raw timing evidence and a Pareto analysis with clearly labeled representations.
